company.name: Verastem Oncology
company.shortDescription: Verastem is a biopharmaceutical company developing new medicines to improve the lives of patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers.
company.description: Verastem Oncology is a late-stage development biopharmaceutical company committed to the development and commercialization of new medicines to improve the lives of patients diagnosed with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. Our pipeline is focused on novel small molecule drugs that inhibit critical signaling pathways in cancer that promote cancer cell survival and tumor growth, including RAF/MEK inhibition, FAK inhibition, and KRAS G12D inhibition.

aiResearchSummary.text: Verastem Oncology is researching therapeutic compositions and combination therapies targeting RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. Their work includes methods using FAK inhibitors with immunotherapeutic agents, KRAS G12D inhibitors with dual RAF/MEK inhibitors, and combinations involving DDR pathway, autophagy pathway, and pan-RAF inhibitors. They also explore oral dosage forms of SHP2, SOS1, ERK1/2, CDK4/6, AKT, mTOR, pan-HER, and EGFR inhibitors with MEK or dual RAF/MEK inhibitors, as well as strategies to reduce toxicity.
